onsiteNote: Friday and Saturday classes every other week in San Francisco, with some three-day weekends; an eight-day opening session in Philadelphia and a six-day Global Business Week trip.
tuitionIncludes: Tuition, program fees, and housing and dining for regular class weekends and required modular courses (a hotel room on Friday nights). Not included: books and supplies, travel to and from campus (including Global Business Week airfare), personal expenses during class weekends, and hotels and dining for elective modular courses or additional class weekends.
campusAddress: 2 Harrison Street (Harrison & Spear) Sixth Floor San Francisco, CA 94105

figureNotes.tuitionUsd: Price for the class entering in 2026; the 2027 price is not published.
figureNotes.cohortMedianExperienceYears: Midpoint of the published 13-14 years average for the Class of 2028.
figureNotes.campusLat: Derived from campusAddress (approximate, from the street address).
figureNotes.campusLon: Derived from campusAddress (approximate, from the street address).
figureNotes.durationMonths: The school's published length; the 2027-2029 San Francisco calendar runs from May 29, 2027 to May 15, 2029.
figureNotes.onsiteDaysPerYear: Counted from the highlighted dates of the 2027-2029 San Francisco calendar: 105 days over two program years (91 San Francisco class days on 41 weekends, 8 days in Philadelphia from May 29 to June 5, 2027, and 6 days of Global Business Week from January 10 to 15, 2028); 61 in the first year, 44 in the second.
figureNotes.longestStretchDays: The opening session in Philadelphia, May 29 to June 5, 2027, on the 2027-2029 San Francisco calendar.
figureNotes.residencyCount: 43 trips on the 2027-2029 San Francisco calendar (41 San Francisco class weekends, the Philadelphia opening session and Global Business Week; 23 in the first year, 20 in the second), so 21.5 a year, rounded up to 22.
figureNotes.accreditation: From AACSB's own directory of accredited schools (University of Pennsylvania, The Wharton School, accredited in Business); Wharton's EMBA pages do not name an accreditor.
